metadata.note: These values reflect public cloud pricing documentation checked as of 2026-09-02. Cloud pricing is dynamic current practice, NOT an immutable computing constant. All calculations must remain parameterized.

block_storage.name: Cloud EBS gp3 General Purpose SSD
block_storage.interface: Raw block device / LBA attached to single host instance
block_storage.primary_use_case: Filesystem root/data volumes, transactional database engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL)

file_storage.name: Cloud Managed EFS Standard File System
file_storage.interface: Hierarchical POSIX filesystem accessed over NFS protocol
file_storage.primary_use_case: Multi-instance shared directories, shared media repositories, container persistent volumes

object_storage.name: Cloud S3 Standard Object Store
object_storage.interface: REST API over HTTP/HTTPS (GET, PUT, DELETE, HEAD) with unique key/bucket namespace
object_storage.primary_use_case: Unstructured binary assets (images, videos, backups, logs, data-lake parquet files)
